title: Align release voice and create incident-aware changelog workflow
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: establish a repeatable editorial process and stakeholder sign-off matrix for release notes that incorporates incident context when relevant, preserves a single voice for customer-facing changelogs, and provides an internal digest for engineering/ops. Scope: templates for customer and internal changelogs, review SLA matrix, implementation of an 'incident flag' field in the release notes draft workflow, training doc for writers and SRE on when to surface incident context. Out-of-scope: automation pipeline to auto-publish to customers (separate infra work). Success metrics: time-to-first-draft <= 48 hours for major releases; stakeholder review turnaround <= 3 business days; post-release customer confusion tickets reduced by 30% in next quarter.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A single canonical customer-facing release template in Drive and Confluence that includes a subtle incident disclosure section; 2) An internal incident-aware digest template for postmortem and RCA links; 3) A signed review matrix with SLAs for Docs, Legal, Security, SRE, and Sales; 4) Training checklist and short walkthrough recorded and published; 5) At least two releases using the new process with retro notes captured.
review_matrix: Owner: PM (Marco Ruiz) drives draft; Docs (Priya) owns tone and clarity; SRE (Daniel) confirms incident facts and links within 24h for incident-tagged drafts; Legal (Marta) reviews for PII and compliance within 48h only for sensitive incidents; Security (Hana) performs quick risk check within 24h if incident flag set; Sales/CS (Jonah) provides customer impact language for enterprise-facing notes within 48h. Final sign-off: PM. SLAs apply per priority level (P0 incidents = 24h total review window).
plan_steps: 1. Create customer-facing and internal changelog templates (Docs) - due 2025-02-18
2. Add 'incident_flag' metadata field to the release notes draft tracker (PM) - due 2025-02-20
3. Convene 45m stakeholder sync to ratify review SLAs (PM + Docs + SRE + Legal + Sales) - scheduled 2025-02-21
4. Produce training doc and 10-minute walkthrough recording (Docs) - due 2025-02-26
5. Run pilot on next two releases and capture retro (PM) - Mar 2025

notes_for_writer: Tone guidance: concise, customer-first, non-technical summary first (1-2 bullets), optional technical appendix for engineers. Use plain language and avoid absolutes; include explicit mitigation steps and links to status page and RCA when available.
